aliases: PillarHall-3; PillarHall prototype 3; Microscopic rectangular PillarHall-3; PillarHall 3rd generation
definition: Microscopic all-silicon lateral high-aspect-ratio channel under a polysilicon membrane supported by pillars, PillarHall 3rd generation prototype (Yim 2020, Sec. C.A; Ylilammi 2018, Sec. I).

aliases: macroscopic, lateral trench; macroscopic test structures
definition: Macroscopic lateral rectangular hole made by stacking two pieces of Si with a spacer in between (Werbrouck 2021, Fig. 3).
A porous body of spherical shape, the reactant entering through its whole surface (a model geometry).
A porous body of slab shape, the reactant entering through its two faces (a model geometry).
A porous body of cylindrical shape, the reactant entering through its curved surface (a model geometry).

aliases: nanoparticle compact; NPC; Al2O3 nanoparticle compact; nanoparticle compacts; NPCs
definition: A pressed compact of Al2O3 nanoparticles (NPC): a macroscopic porous body whose pores the reactants enter from both faces (gre23, Sec. II A, Fig. 1).
A free-standing anodic alumina (AA) membrane: a hexagonal close-packed array of uniform cylindrical nanopores open on both faces, made by anodizing aluminium.
An array of elliptical holes etched into a silicon wafer (0.17 by 0.30 µm, 7.3 µm deep), the step-coverage test structure of Gordon 2003.

aliases: microscopic LHAR; LHAR test structure; microscopic LHAR structure; PillarHall prototype 1
definition: The first microscopic silicon lateral high-aspect-ratio (LHAR) test structure: a lateral cavity 200-1000 nm high and 20-5000 um long inside silicon under a polysilicon membrane on oxide pillars, with a central port; the PillarHall prototype 1 of Gao 2015.

aliases: PillarHall-4; PillarHall LHAR generation 4; LHAR4; LHAR4-ADVANCED; PillarHall 4th generation
definition: PillarHall LHAR generation 4 (LHAR4): the microscopic lateral high-aspect-ratio channel under a polysilicon membrane on silicon pillars, 500 nm nominal gap, with a larger pillar spacing than generation 3; variants LHAR4-ADVANCED trench W90 L1020 and the LHAR4 small chip (vS1, vS2).

aliases: SiO2-capped Si trench; HAR trench; narrow trench; Si trenches
definition: Vertical trenches etched in silicon with an SiO2 capping layer on which the film grows, aspect ratios 2:1 to 10:1, the conformality test structure of van der Zouw 2023.
